name: ZX_CONTENT_SOURCES
description: This table stores Tax Content Providers

columns.name: PROVIDER_ID
columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for tax content provider

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: PROVIDER_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Code of the regime defined by the provider corresponding to a standard regime code published by Oracle

columns.name: STANDARD_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Regime code that identifies the standard regime defined by Oracle. This regime is standardized for a specific geographical area and type of tax.

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code for which this regime is applicable

columns.name: LOADED_FOR_GCO_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether content is loaded for global configuration owner

columns.name: REGIME_PURPOSE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the provider gives content or services for this regime. Possible values are CONTENT and SERVICE. This information will be used to load data for supporting a service subscription.

columns.name: ENTITY_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicates the group of tax configuration entities for which this provider gives content. The data upload process uses this information to invoke loader programs for appropriate entities.

columns.name: VERSION_LOADED
columns.description: Column to store the latest version of the tax content loaded at the isntallation. NULL indicates that the content for this regime has never been loaded at this installation.

columns.name: POINT_RELEASE_VERSION_LOADED
columns.description: Column to store the version of the content loaded at the installation through the latest Oracle point release applied at this installation

columns.name: CONTENT_FILE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the content file. Possible values are EXTERNAL_XML, INTERNAL_XML, EXCEL, LOADER

columns.name: CONTENT_FILE_LOCATION
columns.description: Location of the content file

columns.name: CONTENT_FILE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the content file

columns.name: PROGRAM_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Identifies the date when the program has loaded the latest version of the content

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Program name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Application name of last concurrent program to update this record
